name: Mars Komagatake: image-backed photo creates complete 2022 Edition Bottle

dbOutcome.summary: Production add-bottle flow created bottle 44298 because no Mars Komagatake parent existed. The submitted draft used existing brand Mars (entity 1169) and distiller Shinshu (entity 238555), with expression Komagatake, category single malt, 50% ABV, release year 2022, and edition 2022 Edition flattened onto the bottle row.

provenance.notes: The exact observed extraction is preserved above. At classification time no Mars Komagatake Bottle existed, while Mars, Komagatake, and Shinshu already existed as entities. Hombo's official notice establishes that Mars Shinshu Distillery was renamed Mars Komagatake Distillery effective March 1, 2024. Production Entity 1953 is the canonical Komagatake row and owns the exact Mars Shinshu Distillery alias; Entity 238555 is a later duplicate with no aliases. The observed production flow incorrectly used Entity 238555 for Bottle 44298, so this regression requires reusing Entity 1953 rather than repeating that bad outcome or creating another entity from the printed historical name. The checked-in label and official product page establish single malt as the category, 50% ABV, and 2022 Edition as the annual bottling. Since the 2026-09-16 Mars catalog decision (docs/research/catalog/2026-09-16-mars.md), Komagatake single malts use Entity 1953 (short name Mars Komagatake) as the Brand, and production Bottle 44298 is now Brand 1953, name 2022 Edition, release year 2022 (re-verified 2026-10-24, M11). The local catalog reflects the current Entity 1953 and the sibling Limited Edition Bottles; Entity 238555 stays as the duplicate the production flow chose. Bottle 44298 is recorded only as the subsequent production outcome and is not present in the fixture catalog.

expected.summary: Create the Mars Komagatake 2022 Edition under the existing Mars Komagatake Brand (Entity 1953), named `2022 Edition` with release year 2022, and reuse Entity 1953 as the distiller instead of the historical Shinshu name.
